raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
﻿## Motivation

At `--log-requests-level 1` (the level deployments use when they must not log request/response content), `sampling_params.ebnf` is logged in full. When a client sends a grammar constraint (e.g. an agent harness with tool-calling), that field is a multi-kilobyte grammar string that bloats every request log line while carrying no request or response content. The existing `skip_names` are hardcoded per `--log-requests-level`, so there is no way to elide just `ebnf` without dropping the entire `sampling_params` object (level 0) and losing useful fields like `temperature` / `max_new_tokens`.

This is also distinct from `redact_watermark_secrets`, which masks secret *values* (watermark keys). `ebnf` is not sensitive, just very long and noisy.

## Modifications

- Add `SGLANG_LOG_REQUEST_SKIP_FIELDS` (`EnvTuple`, comma-separated) to `python/sglang/srt/environ.py`.
- In `python/sglang/srt/utils/request_logger.py`, `_compute_metadata` reads it and threads a `skip_value_fields` set through `_dataclass_to_string_truncated` / `_transform_data_for_logging` (and all `log_*_request` call sites). A field whose name is in this set has its value replaced with `"<skipped>"` (JSON: `"<skipped>"`), while `None` is preserved as `None` so "request did not carry the field" stays distinguishable from "request carried it". The match is recursive, so `ebnf` nested inside `sampling_params` is covered.
- This mirrors the `redact_watermark_secrets` pattern (keep the field name, replace the value), but is user-configurable and targeted at large-but-non-sensitive fields rather than secrets.

Usage:

```bash
export SGLANG_LOG_REQUEST_SKIP_FIELDS=ebnf,ebnf_full_assistant
```

Level 1 log line then becomes:

```
sampling_params={'temperature': 0.9, ..., 'ebnf': '<skipped>', 'ebnf_full_assistant': '<skipped>'}
```

When the env var is unset, behavior is unchanged (no field is elided).

## Accuracy Tests

N/A — logging-only change, no effect on model output.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A — logging-only change. The skip check is a set membership test per field, negligible vs. the existing `redact_watermark_secrets` traversal that already runs on every logged request.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). (ruff check/format, isort, codespell all clean)
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (`test/registered/unit/utils/test_request_logger.py`, `base-a-test-cpu`)
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (env var is internal, documented inline; happy to add a docs line if maintainers prefer)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results. (N/A)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+import dataclasses
+import unittest
+from typing import Optional
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.utils.request_logger import (
+    RequestLogger,
+    _dataclass_to_string_truncated,
+    _transform_data_for_logging,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass
+class _SamplingParams:
+    temperature: float = 1.0
+    ebnf: Optional[str] = None
+    ebnf_full_assistant: bool = False
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass
+class _Req:
+    rid: str = "r1"
+    sampling_params: _SamplingParams = dataclasses.field(
+        default_factory=_SamplingParams
+    )
+
+
+class TestSkipValueFieldsText(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_replaces_non_none_value_with_skipped(self):
+        req = _Req(sampling_params=_SamplingParams(ebnf="root ::= " + "a" * 5000))
+        out = _dataclass_to_string_truncated(
+            req, skip_value_fields={"ebnf", "ebnf_full_assistant"}
+        )
+        self.assertIn("ebnf='<skipped>'", out)
+        self.assertIn("ebnf_full_assistant='<skipped>'", out)
+        self.assertNotIn("root ::=", out)
+        # Other fields are preserved.
+        self.assertIn("temperature=1.0", out)
+        self.assertIn("rid='r1'", out)
+
+    def test_preserves_none(self):
+        req = _Req(sampling_params=_SamplingParams(ebnf=None))
+        out = _dataclass_to_string_truncated(req, skip_value_fields={"ebnf"})
+        self.assertIn("ebnf=None", out)
+
+    def test_unset_skip_value_fields_keeps_value(self):
+        req = _Req(sampling_params=_SamplingParams(ebnf="root ::= abc"))
+        out = _dataclass_to_string_truncated(req)
+        self.assertIn("root ::= abc", out)
+
+
+class TestSkipValueFieldsJson(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_replaces_non_none_value_with_skipped(self):
+        req = _Req(
+            sampling_params=_SamplingParams(
+                ebnf="root ::= " + "a" * 5000, ebnf_full_assistant=True
+            )
+        )
+        out = _transform_data_for_logging(
+            req, skip_value_fields={"ebnf", "ebnf_full_assistant"}
+        )
+        sp = out["sampling_params"]
+        self.assertEqual(sp["ebnf"], "<skipped>")
+        self.assertEqual(sp["ebnf_full_assistant"], "<skipped>")
+        self.assertEqual(sp["temperature"], 1.0)
+
+    def test_preserves_none(self):
+        req = _Req(sampling_params=_SamplingParams(ebnf=None))
+        out = _transform_data_for_logging(req, skip_value_fields={"ebnf"})
+        self.assertIsNone(out["sampling_params"]["ebnf"])
+
+    def test_dict_recursive(self):
+        data = {
+            "rid": "r3",
+            "sampling_params": {"temperature": 1.0, "ebnf": "x" * 1000},
+        }
+        out = _transform_data_for_logging(data, skip_value_fields={"ebnf"})
+        self.assertEqual(out["sampling_params"]["ebnf"], "<skipped>")
+        self.assertEqual(out["sampling_params"]["temperature"], 1.0)
+
+
+class TestRequestLoggerSkipFieldsEnv(unittest.TestCase):
+    def _make_logger(self) -> RequestLogger:
+        return RequestLogger(
+            log_requests=True,
+            log_requests_level=1,
+            log_requests_format="text",
+            log_requests_target=None,
+        )
+
+    def test_metadata_reads_env_var(self):
+        with envs.SGLANG_LOG_REQUEST_SKIP_FIELDS.override("ebnf,ebnf_full_assistant"):
+            logger = self._make_logger()
+            _, _, _, skip_value_fields = logger.metadata
+            self.assertEqual(skip_value_fields, {"ebnf", "ebnf_full_assistant"})
+
+    def test_metadata_default_unset(self):
+        with envs.SGLANG_LOG_REQUEST_SKIP_FIELDS.override(""):
+            logger = self._make_logger()
+            _, _, _, skip_value_fields = logger.metadata
+            self.assertIsNone(skip_value_fields)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
